notes:
EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), hostap: src/ap/wpa_auth_ft.c through src/p2p/p2p_pd.c. These 140 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 76 FP, 64 TP.

FP shapes: wpa_auth_ft.c rkh_seq, gsm and r0 from lookups that allocate and check, or that set the out-pointer to a list element on their only success return (medium where the chain spans functions); for_each_element loops over a tested buffer; correlations in tls, nl80211, tncc and p2p code. TP shapes: wps_hostapd.c hapd/conf in statics reached only from open functions (hapd->conf has NULL writers in the tree); for_each_element over an untested parameter of an open function; crypto parameters of open functions; wolfSSL key_der (a third-party contract is not proof); EAP peer configuration from eap_get_config, whose callback can return NULL (medium).

34 row(s) name a conflict in provenance with a carried-forward label that predates the 2026-10-07 rulings; existing rows are not edited.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
